features.evidence: server/app/datasources/base.py 新增 dump_all（默认 NotSupportedError）与 dump capability 约定；server/app/datasources/vector_db_adapter.py memory backend 实现 dump_all + capabilities 增 dump；server/app/datasources/elasticsearch_adapter.py 实现 dump_all（match_all + 全量 text 不分页截断）+ capabilities 增 dump；server/app/observability/migrate.py 新增 dump_chunks（JSONL document_id/text/metadata，分页）/ load_chunks（批量 embedding + Chunk + ds.add）与 dump/load CLI。测试：server/tests/test_migrate.py 2 项（roundtrip 后新库可搜索 / 无 capability 拒绝）、server/tests/datasources/test_elasticsearch_adapter.py +1（dump_all 返回全量文本 + capabilities 含 dump）。验证：pytest 188 → 191 passed；collect-only 191 tests；ruff 0 errors（含清理 math/BaseModel 未用导入）；desktop check/lint 0 errors；Vite 165.98 kB 不变（纯后端）。文档：docs/RUNBOOK.md §3c、docs/elaboration/01-architecture-baseline.md、docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md MI-15、docs/construction/c17-data-migration.md + c17-data-migration-evaluation.md、evaluator-rubric.md、progress.md / session-handoff.md C17 记录。
